description: Fetch the deliverable of an order and check it against the SHA-256 committed on-chain. Uploaded files are hashed here and returned with a temporary download link; text files include a preview. External links are returned with a check of the link hash. Requires login as the buyer or seller.

sessionToken.description: The sessionToken returned by login. Treat it as a secret: never share it or put it in messages.

name: get_deliverable
